content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm planning to create a program on my [product_name] to show the minimum and maximum temperature readings from a PT100/1000 sensor over the last seven days. I'm able to display the values for a single day, but I’m unsure how to shift these readings so that I can view each day's data for a full week. I would greatly appreciate any advice on achieving this. Best regards, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], Thank you for providing this example. This is exactly what I was looking for. I ran a simulation and it works without further modification—just needs to be integrated into my [product_name] system and it's good to go! Thanks again, and best regards.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked for help creating a program with [product_name] to log and display min/max temperatures from a PT100/1000 sensor for the past seven days, specifically needing guidance on shifting daily readings. Another community member shared a ready-to-use example, which the initial user found immediately effective, resulting in positive feedback and appreciation for the support received.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to easily enhance their [product_name] to log and show temperature readings for the previous week, with straightforward integration and minimal further setup.
